Thus did that King of the Monkeys speak and Sushena

" Formerly a great war took place between the Devas and

brief.summary_1line: Garuda appears during the battle, drives away the serpent-arrows binding Rama and Lakshmana, heals them, and warns them about the deceitful warfare of the rakshasas.

image_candidates.scene_text: Garuda descends like a blazing storm as the serpent-arrows binding Rama and Lakshmana flee in terror from his presence.
Garuda gently touches the wounded Rama and Lakshmana, their bloodied bodies glowing again as their wounds close.
The monkey army looks on in awe as the colossal eagle Garuda stands beside the revived princes on the battlefield.
